answer: Nonce-Bound Reply Ledger. Each agent identity must answer a fresh challenge whose correct response depends on a secret kept on a ledge of hardware inaccessible to bulk copying, and the answer is logged once. Replays are rejected. A second identity needs separate hardware plus a lotus of distinct challenge keys, so marginal cost per sybil is a physical device and its enrollment. The ledger records an opal hash per reply, making duplication detectable and unrepeatable.
